method: Post-hoc exact-value byte diagnostic using the separately observed synthetic lighthouse turn; not blind reconstruction
prompt_marker_definition: The exact 32-byte UTF-8 phrase containing the synthetic label, not the full prompt
mapped_process_scope: All nine active chrome.exe processes in the navigated lighthouse profile's PID 3392 browser tree, identified from image-derived pslist and cmdline. The separate still-open older profile's process tree was excluded. Mapped occurrence counts can duplicate aliased physical pages.

process_object_check.interpretation: No process object for the old renderer was returned by either plugin; this is not a physical-page erasure test.

interpretation: The older separate profile still yielded its own complete turn under the frozen parser, but the navigated lighthouse profile did not. Exact lighthouse fragments persisted outside its renderers; neither the invented answer name nor assistant message ID appeared in this image under the two tested encodings. One image does not establish a deletion or recovery rate.
